title: sphenopholis pensylvanica
intro: Sphenopholis pensylvanica, commonly known as Pennsylvania sedge or Pennsylvania bent grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Sphenopholis pensylvanica are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
